title: Reading CSV files with the csv module
author: Docs Team

sections.text: This guide shows how to read a small CSV file in Python and sum one of its columns.

sections.heading: Write a sample file
sections.text: Save a few rows of prices to prices.csv so there is something to read.

sections.heading: Open and read the rows
sections.text: csv.DictReader turns each row into a dictionary keyed by the header.

code.code:
import csv

with open('prices.csv', newline='') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

sections.heading: Sum a column
sections.text: Convert each price to a float and add them up.

code.code:
total = sum(float(r['price']) for r in rows)
print(f'Total: {total:.2f}')

sections.heading: Run it
sections.text: Run the script from the terminal; it prints the total.

sections.heading: Further reading
sections.text: The csv module also writes files; see its reference page.
